cases.question: At which exact commit is uv's main available locally, and does a check with no ref change republish files?
cases.expected: The published revision equals the pinned branch head. An unchanged check reports changed=false and keeps the same snapshot and source manifest.
cases.oracle: Git commit and tree, SQLite published paths and blobs, POST /v1/github/repositories/{id}/refresh.

cases.question: When main advances from the parent to the pinned commit, which accepted paths change and which revision is searchable?
cases.expected: Only crates/uv-fastid/src/lib.rs and crates/uv-fs/src/which.rs change. The search returns only the new revision within this branch, with reopenable coordinates.
cases.oracle: git diff --name-status -M, Git per-revision manifests, SQLite, GET /v1/search.
cases.query: What invariant keeps every byte of the uv-fastid Id valid UTF-8?
cases.sourceText: Every byte belongs to `ALPHABET`, so the bytes are valid UTF-8.

cases.question: Can a search scoped to an unpublished branch return the current main code?
cases.expected: No scoped current results. The same query returns current results on main.
cases.oracle: GET /v1/search with the same repository and query, varying only branch.

cases.question: What safety guarantees replaced the short WinAPI comment in get_binary_type?
cases.questionFr: Quelles garanties de sécurité ont remplacé le commentaire WinAPI dans get_binary_type ?
cases.expected: The name is null-terminated UTF-16, binary_type is a writable u32, and both remain valid during the call. The comparison uses the exact first parent and both cited lines reopen.
cases.oracle: Git diff and both blob byte ranges, GET and POST /v1/github/repositories/{id}/history/comparisons/{child}.

after.text:
// SAFETY: `name` is a null-terminated UTF-16 string, and `binary_type` is a writable
    // `u32`. Both remain valid for the duration of the call.

cases.question: For fixture/alpha's comparison from a…a to b…b, which path was deleted and which path was renamed without a content change?
cases.expected: src/removed.rs was deleted. src/old.rs became src/renamed.rs with the same content. A separate src/z-new.rs was added.
cases.oracle: Accepted fixture tree and blob payloads, explicit_comparison_proves_both_trees_and_first_parent.

cases.question: For fixture/alpha's merge a…a, is the comparison based on the first parent d…d or the other parent e…e?
cases.expected: d…d is the first-parent lineage and is used as the baseline; e…e is listed as a parent but is rejected as a comparison outside the active lineage.

cases.question: Does the Code Graph publish a Rust symbol index for the whole pinned uv workspace?
cases.expected: The large workspace exceeds the product limit of eight conventional Rust roots. The graph reports limit and no entries instead of implying complete coverage.
cases.oracle: git ls-tree of accepted paths, source root limit, GET /v1/github/repositories/{id}/graph.

cases.question: On the small two-module Rust fixture, where is run defined, and to which declaration do the import and call bind?
cases.expected: The definition in src/target.rs is the target of the import and the direct call from src/lib.rs. Each occurrence reopens as the original identifier.
cases.oracle: Graph unit oracle qualified_call_and_import_reopen_their_original_identifier, plus connector graph fixture for the role=call resolution.

cases.question: What happens to a call when its declaration is removed at the next fixture commit, or its source is ambiguous or shadowed?
cases.expected: The indexed call stays unresolved or ambiguous and carries no invented target. The graph revision advances.

cases.question: What was the conclusion of the CI attempt 44806099739/1 on the selected uv main revision?
cases.questionFr: Quelle est la conclusion de la tentative CI 44806099739/1 sur la révision uv sélectionnée de main ?
cases.expected: Attempt 1 completed with success, on main at the exact pinned commit, with verified repository commit provenance.
cases.oracle: Captured GitHub attempt, packaged Actions collection/read API, immutable attempt URL.

cases.question: Can the product prove which exact YAML definition was executed by the selected CI attempt?
cases.expected: No. The known definition blob belongs to the selected commit and can be reopened, while executedDefinition remains unknown.
cases.oracle: Git workflow blob and GitHubActions.executedDefinition. The captured provider record has no executed-definition digest.

cases.question: Do the current source snapshot, history comparison and observed CI attempt agree about the exact child commit? Which parent was compared?
cases.questionFr: La copie locale, la comparaison historique et la tentative CI observée désignent-elles le même commit, et avec quel parent a-t-il été comparé ?
cases.expected: All three records name the pinned child commit, and history names the exact parent. A failed graph projection and an unknown executed workflow remain explicit limitations.
cases.oracle: Cross-check the independently pinned Git tree and parent against current manifest, history materialization and captured provider attempt.
